strategy: Group all findings for the same contract, file, and domain into one Box review task.

fallback.rule: Use for unclassified findings, confidence below threshold, missing experts, or experts without file access.

activationRules: Replace every null boxLogin used by the scenario with a real Box collaborator or managed group.
Verify the selected expert can access the redline file before creating a task.
Never infer a person or login from document text.
Do not create more than one open task for the same contract, file, and domain.
Keep the existing kadams@boxdemo.com assignments as demo triage until named experts are configured.
